title: Birth in New Orleans in 1891
summary: Leclerc was born and has lived all his life in New Orleans; born 21 February 1891, aged 79 and still playing.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: No. I guess they did. Where were you born, Mr. Leclerc?
Right. Oh, I've been in New Orleans all my life. Born here and spent my whole life right here.
Mm-hmm. Do you mind my asking the date of your birth?
I'll have to tell you. It's 1891. I'm an old man.
18? 79. You're 79 years old. 79. And you still play piano? Oh, yes, surely. And what's your birthday?
